attributes.title: [Logs OpenShift] Audit
attributes.description: OpenShift audit logs: Kubernetes and OpenShift API server requests by user, verb, and resource; denied requests; Linux audit records of the nodes; and OVN-Kubernetes network policy decisions.

params.markdown:
## [Logs OpenShift] Audit

Audit logs forwarded by the OpenShift Logging collector (`openshift.audit`):
- API server audit events (`kubeAPI`, `openshiftAPI`)
- Linux audit records of the nodes (`auditd`)
- OVN-Kubernetes ACL logs (`ovn`)

query.esql:
FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| STATS api_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| STATS api_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| STATS audit_records = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| STATS audit_records = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn" AND event.action IN ("drop", "reject")
| STATS dropped = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn" AND event.action IN ("drop", "reject")
| STATS dropped = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), openshift.log_source
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY time_bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 50, ?_tstart, ?_tend), openshift.log_source
| SORT time_bucket ASC

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| EVAL outcome = COALESCE(event.outcome, "unknown")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY event.action, outcome
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| EVAL outcome = COALESCE(event.outcome, "unknown")
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY event.action, outcome
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND user.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY user.name
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND user.name IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY user.name
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| WHERE event.action IN ("create", "update", "patch", "delete", "deletecollection")
| STATS changes = COUNT(*) BY orchestrator.resource.type, event.action
| SORT changes DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI")
| WHERE event.action IN ("create", "update", "patch", "delete", "deletecollection")
| STATS changes = COUNT(*) BY orchestrator.resource.type, event.action
| SORT changes DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND http.response.status_code == 403
| EVAL acting_as = COALESCE(user.effective.name, user.name)
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY acting_as, event.action, orchestrator.resource.type, orchestrator.namespace
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND http.response.status_code == 403
| EVAL acting_as = COALESCE(user.effective.name, user.name)
| STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY acting_as, event.action, orchestrator.resource.type, orchestrator.namespace
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY source.ip
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source IN ("kubeAPI", "openshiftAPI") AND source.ip IS NOT NULL
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY source.ip
| SORT requests DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| EVAL outcome = COALESCE(event.outcome, "unknown")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY event.action, outcome
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 25

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| EVAL outcome = COALESCE(event.outcome, "unknown")
| STATS records = COUNT(*) BY event.action, outcome
| SORT records DESC
| LIMIT 25

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| WHERE event.action IN ("user_auth", "user_acct", "user_login", "user_logout", "login", "cred_acq", "cred_disp", "cred_refr")
| STATS records = COUNT(*), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY host.name, user.name, source.ip
| SORT failed DESC, records DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "auditd"
| WHERE event.action IN ("user_auth", "user_acct", "user_login", "user_logout", "login", "cred_acq", "cred_disp", "cred_refr")
| STATS records = COUNT(*), failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure" BY host.name, user.name, source.ip
| SORT failed DESC, records DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn"
| EVAL policy_kind = COALESCE(rule.ruleset, "other")
| STATS packets = COUNT(*) BY policy_kind, event.action
| SORT packets DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn"
| EVAL policy_kind = COALESCE(rule.ruleset, "other")
| STATS packets = COUNT(*) BY policy_kind, event.action
| SORT packets DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn" AND event.action IN ("drop", "reject")
| STATS packets = COUNT(*) BY rule.name, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port, network.transport
| SORT packets DESC
| LIMIT 20

FROM logs-openshift.audit-*
| WHERE openshift.log_source == "ovn" AND event.action IN ("drop", "reject")
| STATS packets = COUNT(*) BY rule.name, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port, network.transport
| SORT packets DESC
| LIMIT 20
